meaning: The paid S1 driver now refuses a known pre-condition failure where it is found, receipts a failed attempt durably, and counts its real entries with explicit units beside conservative bounds. Nothing paid was executed: S1 remains unauthorized and is NOT run by this revision.

allowed: explicit local git add and commit

carried_over_from_the_prior_session_and_: RNG bridge helpers and the payload-derived expected RNG report in _bundle_to_saved
the three-payload value-by-value comparison extended into verify_restore
ObservedStepEntry refuses a missing or duplicated permit BEFORE delegation
load_state_bundle pins weights_only=False with the torch 2.9.0 default documented
imports extended with os / time / traceback

fail_fast_gates.a1_gate: actor/trunk measurably unmoved, one-to-one and unique eight-object mapping equal to the frozen contract count, both critics carrying a non-empty Adam state; raised BEFORE the first paid native update
fail_fast_gates.bundle_gate: disk file sha256 equals the value recorded at save time, all 14 resume fields present, non-empty data/configuration/code identity and contract, code identity equal to the live sources; raised BEFORE the restore is trusted
fail_fast_gates.a3_start_gate: restored_exactly, zero full-state difference against the A1 baseline, zero raw RNG payload difference, zero drift when the live objects are re-read immediately before the call, bundle cursor equal to the verified cursor, and the update bound to those objects; raised BEFORE the second paid native update

durable_failure_receipts.directory: raw/s1/ (new; the canonical raw/runtime/ ledger is untouched)
durable_failure_receipts.mechanism: append + fsync; the original exception is re-raised unchanged; nothing is retried, refunded or repaired
durable_failure_receipts.unknown_rule: an item that cannot be read is recorded as unknown and listed in unread; it is never defaulted to zero

real_entry_counters.step_attempts_source: computed live from ObservedStepEntry.records, so a refused or failed step is still counted as an attempt
real_entry_counters.bounds: a conservative upper bound per unit is stated before anything runs and is written beside the counted entries, so relabelling can never shrink a real attempt
real_entry_counters.side_effects: recording performs no operation and changes no NN call graph

real_defects_found_and_fixed_this_round.defect: ObservedStepEntry appended TWO records per successful step (a delegated marker plus the completed record), so total_real_steps would read 18 against the frozen 9 and a perfect run would trip the frozen step-count gate
real_defects_found_and_fixed_this_round.fix: exactly ONE terminal record per real step attempt, with the delegation carried by the delegated boolean; the failed record also carries delegated=True

real_defects_found_and_fixed_this_round.defect: a hardcoded expected trainable-object count in the A1 gate would decouple from the live mapping
real_defects_found_and_fixed_this_round.fix: the expected count is parsed from PLAN[gate_only_controller][r71_research_config_unchanged] and the mapping must be unique and equal to it

r75_s1_runner_py_no_argument.result: prints the frozen plan summary, imports no paid module

tests.affected_old_selectors_note: these five encoded the old behaviour (a missing or duplicated permit still delegated) and were rewritten to the refuse-before-delegation contract; the other 35 cases were not touched

comparison_method_statement.compare_full_states: tensor byte digest plus dtype and shape, NOT a real torch Tensor value-by-value path
comparison_method_statement.rng: the three RNG streams are compared as RAW PAYLOADS value by value (tuple/list recursion, tensors by full bytes with dtype and shape)
comparison_method_statement.head_split_equivalence: forward equivalence of the split heads does NOT imply equal gradient norms, equal global clipping or an identical Adam trajectory; the clip algorithm was not modified to manufacture equivalence

consumption.note: the tests redirect S1_DIR to a scratch directory inside the output root and remove it; raw/ still contains only raw/runtime/

disclosed_development_failures: the default tempfile root is not writable under this sandbox; the tests now build their scratch directory inside the R75 output root
a deep single-byte difference fixture made both sides equal at that offset; rebuilt so the first difference is located at byte 2047
an AST ordering test wrongly treated ast.walk BFS order as source order; it now sorts by line number
a json.dumps deep copy of a bundle holding FakeTensor raised TypeError; the bundle product is used directly

a tampered-module test compared both sides against the same payload and therefore could not differ; it now asserts the bundle reproduces exactly while compare_full_states against the baseline reports the module difference
a critic-Adam assertion expected 2 objects where both critic modules contribute 2 parameters each
_installed was applied to a capture_full_state product whose keys are _numpy_state and friends; the states are installed manually
unresolved_boundaries: the outer try starts AFTER _load_paid_modules(), so a failure inside the paid import itself is not receipted; that failure consumes nothing and surfaces as the interpreter traceback. This keeps the existing AST assertions about r75_s1_precheck.main preceding _load_paid_modules intact
if the receipt write itself fails, the original exception is still re-raised unchanged and the receipt is lost; this is printed to stderr
the three new gates coexist with the original end-of-run 13-item failure gate, which is unchanged and still decides the exit code
the weights_only=False compatibility is argued at the documentation and fake-object level only; it was NOT verified against real torch, which this round forbids importing

git.commit_scope: local explicit named commit only; no weights, no raw runtime ledger state, no raw rows/tape/logs, no build artifacts, no protected files
